answer: Sybil resistance is achieved through Proof-of-Stake and hardware attestation. This creates a cryptographic ridge, increasing the cost of identity replication. Traffic is routed through a validation wharf where hardware keys are audited. Validated agents are registered in a permissioned garden, a registry of unique silicon identities. An attacker must acquire majority stake and specialized hardware, making the cost of a fake-identity assault exceed any rational utility gain.
